legenda_completa: Jason Duval’s go-to move in a fight is not a punch. He grabs people and throws them. 😭😂 This short compilation pulls the same move from three different pieces of official Grand Theft Auto VI footage. In the first clip, from today’s new pre-load trailer, Jason, in a white tank top inside a house lit in pink and purple, grabs a man and throws him down. In the second, on the water at sunset, Jason, wearing a black cap and a black t-shirt, locks his arm around another man’s head and shoulder. In the third, on a street at night with a car burning behind them, Jason swings another man through the air by the body. Three separate fights across the trailers, and the same answer every time: get a hand
